newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian stocks end sluggish session mixed.
newsitem.headline: Colombian stocks end sluggish session mixed.

text.p: Colombian stocks ended mixed in markets that were already winding down for the Easter break.
Bogota's IBB index dipped 0.03 percent to 1,067.7 amid 112 million peso volume, while Medellin's IBOMED index gained 0.39 percent to close at 16,621.26 in volume of 848 million pesos.
"There was a real lack of investors and brokers. There were a few cross deals in banks, but nothing significant," one Bogota broker said.
Banco Bancoquia fell 2.77 percent in Bogota to 3,150, while brewing giant Bavaria was unchanged at 6,850.
In Medellin, Banco Industrial Colombiano gained 1.14 percent on a cross deal to close at 3,540. Cigarette manufacturer Coltabaco ended up 2.39 percent at 3,430 in another cross deal in Medellin.
Markets will be closed for Easter holidays until Monday.
